{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Focus on the treatment arm only
treatment_data = final_data[final_data['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response rate by sex within treatment arm
response_by_sex_treatment = treatment_data.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Compute response rate by sex and severity within treatment arm
response_by_sex_severity_treatment = treatment_data.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute difference (female - male) by severity in treatment arm
female_response = response_by_sex_severity_treatment.loc['F']
male_response = response_by_sex_severity_treatment.loc['M']
difference_by_severity = female_response - male_response

# Print all required values
print(f"Mean response rate (female, treatment arm): {response_by_sex_treatment['F']:.3f}")
print(f"Mean response rate (male, treatment arm): {response_by_sex_treatment['M']:.3f}")
print(f"Difference (female - male, treatment arm): {response_by_sex_treatment['F'] - response_by_sex_treatment['M']:.3f}")
print(f"Difference in response rate (female - male) by severity in treatment arm:")
print(f"  mild: {difference_by_severity['mild']:.3f}")
print(f"  moderate: {difference_by_severity['moderate']:.3f}")
print(f"  severe: {difference_by_severity['severe']:.3f}")

# Return the values
(response_by_sex_treatment['F'], response_by_sex_treatment['M'], response_by_sex_treatment['F'] - response_by_sex_treatment['M'], difference_by_severity['mild'], difference_by_severity['moderate'], difference_by_severity['severe'])"}
